input.sha256_scope: Concatenation of the eighteen raw row-major zero/one bitmap byte arrays in capture document order.
input.provenance: Self-authored binary bitmaps written as row strings in tools/capture_contour_oracle.py.

expected.sha256_scope: Concatenation of each case's contour list serialised as compact JSON, in capture document order.

limitations: src/contour.rs reproduces every recorded case exactly, including contour order, in the recorded scalar OpenCV 5.0.0 environment.
It covers cv2.findContours with RETR_LIST and CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE on eighteen self-authored bitmaps in the recorded scalar OpenCV 5.0.0 environment, and nothing else.
Contour order is recorded because upstream truncates by index to max_candidates; a later implementation must reproduce the order, not only the point sets.
It does not establish minimum-area boxes, unclipping, scoring, rescaling, detector output, model behaviour, or OCR compatibility.
